answer: Work waits on the marble until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the echo of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
